rules: Effects of one assumption are evaluated simultaneously against the row as it was before that assumption; assumptions apply in the order listed here. Formulas use the language of docs/data-standard.md §6.

assumptions.name_technical: Stellar mass-to-light ratio of the disc at 3.6 µm, Υ_disk
assumptions.name_plain: How much mass each unit of starlight in the disc stands for

aeg-d-sparc/v1.default_ref: Lelli, McGaugh & Schombert 2016 (arXiv:1606.09251), 'as suggested by stellar population models'; Lelli et al. 2017 (arXiv:1610.08981) Table 1
aeg-d-sparc/v1.range_ref: Lelli, McGaugh & Schombert 2016 (arXiv:1606.09251) abstract: 0.2 as suggested by the DiskMass survey; 0.7 the mean maximum-disk limit in bright galaxies

assumptions.name_technical: Stellar mass-to-light ratio of the bulge at 3.6 µm, Υ_bul
assumptions.name_plain: How much mass each unit of starlight in the central bulge stands for

aeg-d-sparc/v1.default_ref: Lelli et al. 2017 (arXiv:1610.08981) Table 1; equals 1.4 Υ_disk at the disc default (arXiv:1606.09251 eq. 7)
aeg-d-sparc/v1.range_ref: 1.4 × the disc range, following the source's adopted relation Υ_bul = 1.4 Υ_disk, 'as suggested by SPS models' (arXiv:1606.09251 eq. 7)

assumptions.name_technical: Galaxy distance, within its published one-sigma error
assumptions.name_plain: How far away the galaxy is

parameter.unit: published one-sigma errors from the catalogue distance

aeg-d-sparc/v1.default_ref: SPARC Table 1 distance D and error e_D, per galaxy (arXiv:1606.09251)
aeg-d-sparc/v1.range_ref: SPARC Table 1 e_D, per galaxy. At fixed angle R scales with D, so g_obs = V²/R scales as 1/D; g_bar is distance independent (arXiv:1610.08981 §II.1.2)

assumptions.name_technical: Disc inclination, within its published one-sigma error
assumptions.name_plain: How tilted the disc is as we see it

parameter.unit: published one-sigma errors from the catalogue inclination

aeg-d-sparc/v1.default_ref: SPARC Table 1 inclination and error, per galaxy (arXiv:1606.09251)
aeg-d-sparc/v1.range_ref: SPARC Table 1 e_Inc, per galaxy. V_obs scales as 1/sin i, so g_obs scales as 1/sin² i; the source's g_bar error carries no inclination term (arXiv:1610.08981 eq. 2 and §II.1.2)

assumptions.name_technical: Helium correction to atomic-hydrogen gas mass
assumptions.name_plain: Allowance for helium mixed in with the hydrogen gas

aeg-d-sparc/v1.default_ref: SPARC Table 2 note 2; arXiv:1606.09251 §III.3: total gas mass 1.33 M_HI

aeg-d-dwarfs/v1.default_ref: Register default (Lelli et al. 2016, arXiv:1606.09251 §III.3, read at source); D-034, D-058
aeg-d-dwarfs/v1.note: Not adjustable until a published range is read (D-034).

assumptions.name_technical: Deprojection of the lensing excess surface density to g_obs: singular isothermal sphere, g_obs = 4 G ΔΣ
assumptions.name_plain: How the light-bending measurement is turned into a pull at a given distance

aeg-d-kids1000-rar/v1.default_ref: Brouwer et al. 2021 (arXiv:2106.11677) §2.2, eq. 7; validated by the authors against a piece-wise power-law method assuming only spherical symmetry (App. B, §4.4)

assumptions.name_technical: Hot gas around isolated galaxies: isothermal, within 100 h70⁻¹ kpc, mass equal to the stellar mass
assumptions.name_plain: An allowance for hot, hard-to-see gas around galaxies

aeg-d-kids1000-rar/v1.default_ref: Brouwer et al. 2021 (arXiv:2106.11677) Fig. 4 caption and §5.2: 'only a rough order of magnitude estimate'; applies to the kids_bright_hotgas sample only

assumptions.name_technical: X-ray hydrostatic bias b, with M_true = M_hydrostatic / (1 − b)
assumptions.name_plain: How much of the gas's support against the pull is missed by assuming pressure balance from heat alone

aeg-d-xcop/v1.default_ref: Eckert et al. 2019 (arXiv:1805.00034): non-thermal pressure about 6 % at R500 and 10 % at R200; hydrostatic masses 'require little correction'. D-022
aeg-d-xcop/v1.range_ref: Eckert et al. 2019 (arXiv:1805.00034): 1 − b = 0.85 ± 0.05 for Planck SZ-based masses; 0.2 is its one-sigma edge. D-022

assumptions.name_technical: Intracluster light: share f of total cluster starlight not counted in the measured stellar masses
assumptions.name_plain: Starlight spread between the galaxies that the star counts leave out

aeg-d-xcop/v1.default_ref: Ghizzardi et al. 2020 (arXiv:2007.01084): measured stellar masses include the central galaxy and exclude intracluster light. D-022
aeg-d-xcop/v1.range_ref: Span given by Ghizzardi et al. 2020: Zibetti et al. 2005, 10.9 ± 5.0 % within 500 kpc; Zhang et al. 2019, 44 ± 17 % within 1 Mpc (includes the central galaxy, so 0.5 is generous). Assumed to follow the measured stars' radial distribution. D-022

assumptions.name_technical: Stellar mass of clusters without measured stars: NFW-shaped profile, c = 2.9 relative to r200, normalised by M★/M_gas(<R500) = 0.39 (M500/1e14 M☉)^−0.84
assumptions.name_plain: An estimate of the stars' mass in clusters where they were not measured

aeg-d-xcop/v1.default_ref: Ettori et al. 2019 (arXiv:1805.00035) §5; concentration from Lin et al. 2004 (arXiv:astro-ph/0402308); normalisation from Gonzalez et al. 2013; M500 and R200 from Ettori et al. 2019 Table 1. D-022
aeg-d-xcop/v1.note: No slider until Gonzalez et al. 2013 is read at source for the relation's scatter and its treatment of the central galaxy and intracluster light (D-022).

assumptions.name_technical: Spherical symmetry and dynamical equilibrium; half-light-radius mass estimator M(<r½) = 3 σ²_los r½ / G (Wolf et al. 2010)
assumptions.name_plain: The cluster is treated as round and settled, and its stars' motions as balancing its pull

assumptions.name_technical: 3D half-light radius r½ = 4/3 × projected half-light radius R_h
assumptions.name_plain: Turning the half-light size seen on the sky into a size in space

assumptions.name_technical: Light weights and R_h from the King (1966) model fitted by McLaughlin & van der Marel (2005); bin edges inferred from mean radii
assumptions.name_plain: How the cluster's light is spread out, used to weight the motions

aeg-d-gc-baumgardt/v1.default_ref: D-036 (ii), D-045, D-047; McLaughlin & van der Marel 2005 (ApJS 161, 304) Table 10 (VizieR models)

assumptions.name_technical: Distance from horizontal-branch photometry, Harris (1996, 2010 edition)
assumptions.name_plain: How far away the cluster is, from the brightness of a type of star

aeg-d-gc-baumgardt/v1.note: No slider yet: Harris gives no per-cluster distance error.

assumptions.name_technical: Stellar mass-to-light ratio Υ_V from population synthesis (Bruzual & Charlot 2003, Chabrier disk IMF), per cluster
assumptions.name_plain: How much mass each unit of starlight stands for

parameter.unit: position in the published range: −1 = 0.53 × default, 0 = default, +1 = Salpeter value

aeg-d-gc-baumgardt/v1.default_ref: D-039; McLaughlin & van der Marel 2005 §3 and Table 8 (VizieR clusters, (M/L)1); M_V,sun = 4.85 (their §4.2)
aeg-d-gc-baumgardt/v1.range_ref: D-039 item 3. Lower end: 0.53 × the population value, the smallest dissolution factor Q in Kruijssen & Mieske 2009 (arXiv:0903.4683) §2, Table 1 (Q = 0.53–1.00), a range bound only, never a per-cluster default. Upper end: each cluster's BC03 + Salpeter value, McLaughlin & van der Marel 2005 (M/L)2 (Salpeter 60–75% above Chabrier, their §3). Asymmetric by construction; read at source: docs/sources/stellar-ml-2026-10-29.md.

range_basis.min: Kruijssen & Mieske 2009, smallest Q = 0.53 (loss of low-mass stars by dissolution)
range_basis.max: McLaughlin & van der Marel 2005, (M/L)_V with a Salpeter IMF, per cluster

aeg-d-gc-baumgardt/v1.evidence: Direct low-mass IMF evidence read at source (D-039 item 2, docs/sources/stellar-ml-2026-10-29.md): consistent with the Chabrier/Kroupa default; neither source supports a Salpeter-like low-mass IMF in these systems.

assumptions.name_technical: Gas absent from g_bar: literature limit for the kind
assumptions.name_plain: Gas in globular clusters is too little to count

assumptions.name_technical: Spherical symmetry and dynamical equilibrium; half-light-radius mass estimator M(<r½) = 3 σ²_los r½ / G (Wolf et al. 2010)
assumptions.name_plain: The galaxy is treated as round and settled, and its stars' motions as balancing its pull
assumptions.not_adjustable_reason: assumed by the method; not tested by the Atlas

assumptions.name_technical: 3D half-light radius r½ = 4/3 × circularised projected half-light radius R_h
assumptions.name_plain: Turning the half-light size seen on the sky into a size in space
assumptions.not_adjustable_reason: assumed by the method; not tested by the Atlas

assumptions.name_technical: R_h = a √(1 − ε) from the structural original's semi-major half-light radius; where the paper does not state the convention and fits an ellipticity, its r_h is taken as semi-major (flag x_dwarfs_flags rh_semimajor_assumed)
assumptions.name_plain: Averaging the galaxy's stretched outline into one size
assumptions.not_adjustable_reason: assumed by the method; not tested by the Atlas

assumptions.name_technical: Distance from the LVDB distance original, stellar-population methods only (RR Lyrae, horizontal branch, red-giant tip, red clump); never kinematic
assumptions.name_plain: How far away the galaxy is, from the brightness of particular kinds of star

aeg-d-dwarfs/v1.default_ref: D-036 #6, D-052, D-055 item 8, D-061 item 4; reading/distance_method_audit.csv
aeg-d-dwarfs/v1.note: Enters g_obs and g_bar together; no slider.

assumptions.not_adjustable_reason: assumed by the method; not tested by the Atlas

assumptions.name_technical: Extinction-corrected apparent V rebuilt as M_V plus the modulus the paper used, where only M_V is printed (D-052 item 4; D-061 items 3, 5–7); distance-independent M_V used directly for Boötes III (D-061 item 2)
assumptions.name_plain: Placing the galaxy's brightness at the adopted distance
assumptions.not_adjustable_reason: assumed by the method; not tested by the Atlas

assumptions.name_technical: Gas mass inside r½ taken as half the total HI mass (Putman et al. 2021 Table 1 gives totals only), flag x_dwarfs_flags gas_half_total
assumptions.name_plain: How much of the galaxy's gas lies within its half-light size
assumptions.not_adjustable_reason: assumed by the method; not tested by the Atlas

assumptions.name_technical: HI masses and limits rescaled by (D_package / D_Putman)² (M_HI = 2.36 × 10⁵ S D²; Putman et al. 2021 §2)
assumptions.name_plain: Moving the hydrogen gas mass to the adopted distance
assumptions.not_adjustable_reason: assumed by the method; not tested by the Atlas

assumptions.name_technical: Stellar mass-to-light ratio Υ_V from population synthesis (Bruzual & Charlot 2003, Chabrier disk IMF), interpolated in [Fe/H] in McLaughlin & van der Marel (2005) per-cluster values at 13 ± 2 Gyr
assumptions.name_plain: How much mass each unit of starlight stands for

parameter.unit: position in the published range: −1 = the D-060 lower bound, 0 = default, +1 = the D-060 upper bound

aeg-d-dwarfs/v1.default_ref: D-039, D-057, D-059; McLaughlin & van der Marel 2005 (VizieR J/ApJS/161/304/clusters, (M/L)1, Milky Way clusters), interpolated by aeg.ml_interp; below [Fe/H] = −2.29 the end value, flag beyond_source_range; M_V,sun = 4.85
aeg-d-dwarfs/v1.range_ref: D-060: lower = min over [Fe/H] ± s of ((M/L)1 − e1) × 0.90 × 0.81; upper = max of ((M/L)2 + e2) × 1.10. 0.90: BC03 vs PÉGASE within ~10% (McLaughlin & van der Marel 2005 §3.1); 0.81 = 1.3/1.6, Woo et al. 2008 median Υ_V from colours vs star-formation histories; (M/L)2: Salpeter IMF. Read at source: docs/sources/stellar-ml-2026-10-29.md.

range_basis.min: D-060 envelope lower bound (age/metallicity error, metallicity spread, code agreement, colour vs SFH)
range_basis.max: D-060 envelope upper bound (Salpeter IMF, code agreement)

effects.formula: g_bar_stars * (1 + ((x_dwarfs_upsilon_v_high / x_dwarfs_upsilon_v - 1 + 1 - x_dwarfs_upsilon_v_low / x_dwarfs_upsilon_v) / 2) * p + ((x_dwarfs_upsilon_v_high / x_dwarfs_upsilon_v - 1 - 1 + x_dwarfs_upsilon_v_low / x_dwarfs_upsilon_v) / 2) * abs(p))

g_bar_err_lo * (1 + ((x_dwarfs_upsilon_v_high / x_dwarfs_upsilon_v - 1 + 1 - x_dwarfs_upsilon_v_low / x_dwarfs_upsilon_v) / 2) * p + ((x_dwarfs_upsilon_v_high / x_dwarfs_upsilon_v - 1 - 1 + x_dwarfs_upsilon_v_low / x_dwarfs_upsilon_v) / 2) * abs(p))

g_bar_err_hi * (1 + ((x_dwarfs_upsilon_v_high / x_dwarfs_upsilon_v - 1 + 1 - x_dwarfs_upsilon_v_low / x_dwarfs_upsilon_v) / 2) * p + ((x_dwarfs_upsilon_v_high / x_dwarfs_upsilon_v - 1 - 1 + x_dwarfs_upsilon_v_low / x_dwarfs_upsilon_v) / 2) * abs(p))

g_bar_stars * (1 + ((x_dwarfs_upsilon_v_high / x_dwarfs_upsilon_v - 1 + 1 - x_dwarfs_upsilon_v_low / x_dwarfs_upsilon_v) / 2) * p + ((x_dwarfs_upsilon_v_high / x_dwarfs_upsilon_v - 1 - 1 + x_dwarfs_upsilon_v_low / x_dwarfs_upsilon_v) / 2) * abs(p)) + g_bar_gas_cold

assumptions.name_technical: Light deflection by the projected mass inside the Einstein radius as in general relativity: M_E = θ_E² c² D_s D_l / (4 G D_ls) (A6S_PRECEDENCE §2.4)
assumptions.name_plain: Light-bending measures the pull of everything inside the ring of the lensed images
assumptions.not_adjustable_reason: assumed by the method; not tested by the Atlas

assumptions.name_technical: Distances in the flat ΛCDM cosmology stated by the source of each θ_E (H0, Ω_m; Ω_Λ = 1 − Ω_m as printed, D-075 item 4)
assumptions.name_plain: Distances to the lens and the background galaxy from each paper's own expansion model

aeg-d-strong-lensing/v1.note: Enters M_E and R_E; g_obs/g_bar does not depend on it to first order (D-064 item 4). No slider.

assumptions.not_adjustable_reason: assumed by the method; not tested by the Atlas

assumptions.name_technical: Both sides are masses inside the same projected cylinder of radius R_E, expressed as G M / R_E² and labelled projected (D-064)
assumptions.name_plain: Both pulls are measured through the same cylinder, seen in projection
assumptions.not_adjustable_reason: assumed by the method; not tested by the Atlas

assumptions.name_technical: Lens and source redshifts measured spectroscopically, neither derived from the lens's velocity dispersion (D-063 items 3, 5)
assumptions.name_plain: Both distances come from measured spectra
assumptions.not_adjustable_reason: assumed by the method; not tested by the Atlas

assumptions.name_technical: Stellar mass from photometry and a stellar-population model with a named IMF (printed mass, or luminosity × population M/L; D-063 item 1, D-075 item 3)
assumptions.name_plain: How much mass the starlight stands for, from models of how stars age
assumptions.not_adjustable_reason: assumed by the method; not tested by the Atlas

assumptions.name_technical: Where only a total stellar mass is printed: the fraction inside R_E from the source's own light profile (de Vaucouleurs or Sérsic; aeg.lensing.sersic_projected_fraction), assuming mass follows light (A6S_PRECEDENCE §3.1)
assumptions.name_plain: The share of the starlight that falls inside the ring, from the galaxy's measured light profile

aeg-d-strong-lensing/v1.default_ref: A6S_PRECEDENCE §3.1; D-075 item 5 (S4TM R10 fit; SL2S CFHT fit)
aeg-d-strong-lensing/v1.note: Checked on SLACS against R13's printed masses inside R_E (checks/profile_step.ecsv; reported, not pass/fail).

assumptions.not_adjustable_reason: assumed by the method; not tested by the Atlas

assumptions.name_technical: Stellar initial mass function: Chabrier/Kroupa as printed (default) to Salpeter (top), from the same source's printed Salpeter mass or printed conversion; S4TM from R30's printed FSPS factor (Chabrier / 0.61)
assumptions.name_plain: How many faint, low-mass stars there are for each bright one

aeg-d-strong-lensing/v1.range_ref: Top: Salpeter value printed by the same source (R13 Salpeter-BC03; R20 Salpeter), else the source's printed conversion (R29 α = 1.55; R32 α ≈ 1.65, flag salpeter_factor_approx_printed; R30 ÷ 0.61), and for S4TM R30's printed FSPS factor ÷ 0.61 = × 1.64 (D-076 item 2; other printed conversions span 1.55-1.71, reading/gas/adjudication_gas.md §6). Rows without a top (SNELLS: none read) are not offered the slider (flag imf_top_not_read).

range_basis.max: the Salpeter value or printed conversion (A6S_PRECEDENCE §3.2; D-076 item 2)

assumptions.name_technical: Gas inside R_E as fractions of M*(<R_E) at the default IMF: hot X-ray gas default 0.12% (range 0.015-2.5%), cold gas (molecular plus atomic) default 0 (range 0-2%); total 0.12% (0.015-4.5%) (D-076 item 1, option G1)
assumptions.name_plain: How much gas sits inside the ring, compared with the stars

parameter.unit: position in the registered range: −1 = minimum, 0 = default, +1 = maximum (each component)

aeg-d-strong-lensing/v1.default_ref: D-076 item 1 (option G1): hot default 0.12% = median of 28 same-aperture X-ray gas and stellar measurements of early-type galaxies (25 detected); cold default 0 (molecular: 40 of 56 are limits; atomic: central HI undetected in 85% of high-mass ATLAS3D early-types). gas_term.json; reading/gas/adjudication_gas.md §3-5
aeg-d-strong-lensing/v1.range_ref: Hot: lowest measured 0.015% to highest measured 2.5%; cold: 0 to 2% (molecular top from a published bound of about 1%, atomic top from a flagged sample bound of about 1%). Radii never rescaled; single-dish beams at half their printed width; non-detections kept as limits (D-076 item 1).

range_basis.min: lowest measured value (hot); zero (cold, allowed by the limits)

effects.formula: g_obs * x_strong_lensing_mstar_re_msun / x_strong_lensing_m_e_msun * (x_strong_lensing_gas_hot_frac + (x_strong_lensing_gas_hot_frac_max - x_strong_lensing_gas_hot_frac_min) / 2 * p + (x_strong_lensing_gas_hot_frac_max + x_strong_lensing_gas_hot_frac_min - 2 * x_strong_lensing_gas_hot_frac) / 2 * abs(p))

g_obs * x_strong_lensing_mstar_re_msun / x_strong_lensing_m_e_msun * (x_strong_lensing_gas_cold_frac + (x_strong_lensing_gas_cold_frac_max - x_strong_lensing_gas_cold_frac_min) / 2 * p + (x_strong_lensing_gas_cold_frac_max + x_strong_lensing_gas_cold_frac_min - 2 * x_strong_lensing_gas_cold_frac) / 2 * abs(p))

g_bar - g_bar_gas_hot - g_bar_gas_cold + g_obs * x_strong_lensing_mstar_re_msun / x_strong_lensing_m_e_msun * ((x_strong_lensing_gas_hot_frac + (x_strong_lensing_gas_hot_frac_max - x_strong_lensing_gas_hot_frac_min) / 2 * p + (x_strong_lensing_gas_hot_frac_max + x_strong_lensing_gas_hot_frac_min - 2 * x_strong_lensing_gas_hot_frac) / 2 * abs(p)) + (x_strong_lensing_gas_cold_frac + (x_strong_lensing_gas_cold_frac_max - x_strong_lensing_gas_cold_frac_min) / 2 * p + (x_strong_lensing_gas_cold_frac_max + x_strong_lensing_gas_cold_frac_min - 2 * x_strong_lensing_gas_cold_frac) / 2 * abs(p)))

aeg-d-strong-lensing/v1.note: The five systems whose sources state gas negligible (SNL-0, SNL-1, SNL-2, J1436+4943, J1701+3722) take the same term; the statements are kept as notes (D-076 item 1).
